logo.note: No logo yet: GitHub's logo guidelines permit its logos only to link to GitHub, to show an integration with GitHub or in writing about GitHub, and forbid using one as a project's logo or combining it with other words; anything else needs GitHub's prior written permission. Primer has no mark of its own; the Invertocat can go here once GitHub permits it.

provenance.notes: Primer's base and functional scales and its two theme files are vendored verbatim under scripts/sources/primer; the generator reads their custom properties.
